scope: Match Monitoring tree styling to the policy editor and widen the desktop tree while retaining tree-and-details inspection.
owner: One implementation owner in Homeostatic; health-tree unchanged

status.broader_reconnect_acceptance: fail on candidate and earlier release baseline

purpose_review.owner: Monitoring owns source status and inspection; Policies owns membership editing.
purpose_review.shared_visuals: Both trees use common CSS values for 48px minimum rows, 24px indentation and 44px disclosure targets. Monitoring uses bold top-level names and subtle separators.
purpose_review.layout: The desktop tree grows from 30% to 38% with a 300px minimum, keeping selected-source details beside it. Phones retain successive tree/detail views and Back to Monitoring.
purpose_review.content: Remove repeated Integration/Device type labels from groups; keep Issues badges and meaningful connection/entity coverage below names.
purpose_review.disclosure: The independent arrow exposes children without selecting or editing. Selecting a name opens its existing canonical details.
purpose_review.rendered_review: Inspected desktop and phone light-theme screenshots plus enlarged phone text; long names wrap, selection and keyboard outlines remain distinct, and controls fit. Dark themes and 320px geometry also pass.
purpose_review.contracts: No monitoring, Home Assistant evidence, persistence, event or notification contract changes; docs/events.md is unchanged.

checks.notes: Three warnings concern existing unrelated accent borders; no new tree findings.
